sections.heading: Monthly Nutrition Class
sections.markdown:

* [Join](https://meeting.marinenet.usmc.mil/mcbqnutritionclass/) the meeting!

sections.heading: Cooking Classes
sections.markdown: Participants learn how to cook delicious and nutritious meals and then enjoy the healthful foods they cooked. Each class has a different theme based on the season or chosen health topic. Cooking classes are offered quarterly. To sign up for a cooking class, please contact the Registered Dietitian at 703.784.2869 or send a sign-up request to [mccsquanticobpaceventregistration@usmc-mccs.org](mailto:mccsquanticobpaceventregistration@usmc-mccs.org).

sections.heading: Individual Nutrition Counseling
sections.markdown:
The Semper Fit Dietitian helps individuals reach their health goals. Each client receives a diet assessment plus expert advice and tips on how to make successful, lifestyle changes. **Counseling sessions are by appointment only.**

* Active Duty: Free
* Dependents. Reservists, and Retirees: $25 (Dependents must be 12+ years of age).
* DoD Civilians: $40
* Contractors: $50

sections.heading: Resting Metabolic Rate Testing
sections.markdown:
Managing your weight is dependent on being in control of how many calories you should eat every day. Your resting metabolic rate is the number of calories your body burns each day with little or no activity. An accurate measurement will put you in control of your weight. **RMR testing is by appointment only.**

* Active Duty: $15 per test **\*Free for Marines on BCP\***
* Retirees, Reservists, DoD Civilians, and Dependents: $25 per test
* Contractors: $35 per test

sections.heading: Nutrition Briefs
sections.markdown: We will come to you! Nutrition and health briefs are available to all units and civilian offices aboard Quantico. Brief topics can include but are not limited to: Nutrition Basics, Weight Management (BCP), Sports Nutrition and Injuries, Supplement Awareness, and Healthy Eating on-the-go, Dietary Supplements, and more.

sections.heading: Grocery Store Tour
sections.markdown:
Tours are offered by appointment at the Quantico Commissary.

Go through the aisles with the Semper Fit Dietitian and discuss healthy food options in the grocery store. Discuss how to compile a healthy grocery list and learn to read food labels correctly.

Available to all patrons and units in groups of three (3) or more.

sections.heading: Event Support
sections.markdown: Do you want to include nutrition education at another event? We can provide activities and displays appropriate for your audience.
